Why This Hotel Fits

A central Bengaluru base with meeting space, rooms and dining under one roof.

cards.text:
Central & Connected

About 1 km from Bengaluru City Railway Station and Kempegowda Bus Station; 34 km from Kempegowda International Airport.

Everything Onsite

Equus banquet hall, Gallop & Canter breakout rooms and about 1,650 sq ft of flexible event space.

Budget Alignment

Clear group rates, concessions and transparent fees in one estimate you can take into approval.

Planner Confidence

Rooftop pool and 17th-floor TurfView overlooking the racecourse and Vidhana Soudha.

data.text:
Guest Rooms

272 rooms, including 22 premium rooms with private balconies and 22 suites with separate living and dining areas, premium bedding and complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi.
